name: AM2R GX
longDescription:
AM2R GX — AM2R 1.5.5 (Community Update) on the Wii, built on the Butterscotch engine with native GX. Bring your own AM2R 1.1 zip; the first boot builds 1.5.5 from it. Hold HOME, or X + B + Start on a GameCube controller, to quit.

Free software under the AGPL-3.0: see LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt.

Not affiliated with Nintendo, YoYo Games, DoctorM64, or the AM2R Community Developers.
longDescriptionDraft:
AM2R GX is a Wii port of AM2R (Another Metroid 2 Remake) 1.5.5, running on Butterscotch, an open-source GameMaker runner.

You'll need your own copy of the original AM2R 1.1 release zip. The first boot builds 1.5.5 from it, which takes about four minutes.

name: ASCII Odyssey
longDescription:
Press start and ASCII Odyssey makes you a brand new voyage: a tracker song composed from a seed, with a light show drawn only in text that dances to the beat.

Ten genres, a hundred scenes, and dozens of color palettes. <3
longDescriptionDraft:
ASCII Odyssey is a Wii app that composes a brand-new voyage every time you press Start: a tracker song created from a seed, with a light show drawn only from text that dances to the beat.

It has ten genres, a hundred scenes, and sixty color palettes.

name: Bird & Beans GX
longDescription:
Native port of the DSiWare release, Bird & Beans / Pyoro.
Playable with Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller and GameCube Controller.
Put your supported USA .nds ROM beside boot.dol. Data is prepared automatically on first launch.
Adorable Pyoro transition voices included. <3
longDescriptionDraft:
A Wii homebrew port of Bird & Beans / Pyoro, with both games, original gameplay code, music and sound effects, and a new title screen and pause menu.

You'll need your own (USA)(EnFrEs) DSiWare ROM.

name: Empty Slot Creator
longDescription: Pick a homebrew app and get a WAD for a channel that looks like an unused slot on the Wii Menu and opens that app. The WAD is saved to sd:/wad; install it with a WAD manager such as YAWMM ModMii Edition.
longDescriptionDraft:
A Homebrew Channel app that makes invisible forwarder channel WADs. You can select any homebrew software you have installed, and the app will generate a WAD for you to install with the WAD manager of your choice.

The installed channel looks exactly like an unused slot on the Wii Menu, and can only be detected when hovered over. The banner recreates the same look as the icon and has gentle white noise as its audio.

name: Paper Airplane Chase GX
longDescription:
Native port of the DSiWare release, Paper Airplane Chase.
Playable with Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller and GameCube Controller.
Put your supported USA .nds ROM beside boot.dol. Data is prepared automatically on first launch.
Endless, Time Attack courses and local two-player Race included.
Race uses whichever controller clicked on "Race" as Player 1 and whichever controller responds next as Player 2.
longDescriptionDraft:
A Wii homebrew port of Paper Airplane Chase, with Endless, all eight Time Attack courses and local two-player Race, original gameplay code, music and sound effects, and a new title screen and pause menu.

You'll need your own (USA)(EnFrEs) DSiWare ROM.

name: sdk/mii Demo
longDescription:
Demo for sdk/mii, from hbc-reborn. Displays the Miis that exist on your Wii and information about them. Their faces and bodies are read straight from your system.

Music: Focus Loop by FreeGroove (Pixabay)
longDescriptionDraft:
sdk/mii Demo is a Wii app that shows every Mii on your Wii in 3D, with their faces and bodies read straight from the system. It's a demo of sdk/mii, the Mii renderer from hbc-reborn.

Music: Focus Loop by FreeGroove (Pixabay)

name: VBoy Color GX
longDescription:
VBoy Color GX is a port of VBoy Color to the Wii, using Tantric's GX frontend.

Optimized for steady performance during gameplay. Includes many different color options.

Supports Wii Remote + Nunchuk, Classic Controller, Wii U Pro Controller, GameCube controller, and the Wii U GamePad in vWii.
longDescriptionDraft: VBoy Color GX is a Wii port of VBoy Color, a Virtual Boy emulator that adds color. It uses a modified version of Tantric's FCE Ultra GX frontend for a clean, familiar way to browse and load games.

name: VectrexWii
longDescription: Wii port of Vecx - a vectrex emulator written by Valavan Manohararajah.
longDescriptionDraft:
VectrexWii is a Wii port of Vecx, a Vectrex emulator written by Valavan Manohararajah.

Originally ported by community member Aruskano, and now maintained by cmyksoda, it seeks to bring as much of the charm of the Vectrex to the Wii as possible.

name: WiiCam
longDescription:
Take photos and record video with a USB camera. It can record sound, too.

In testing, sound works at every resolution. However, it only stays available at the size the camera first opened with. To record sound at another size, restart WiiCam; the menu tells you when.

After a photo, or a video stopped with A, a review page opens: 1 plays the video back, and Minus twice deletes it.

Choose a size from 160 x 120 up to 848 x 480 (depending on the camera), set a 3, 5 or 10 second photo timer, or refresh the camera source from the menu.

Photos are saved to SD:/DCIM/100WC04 and videos to SD:/wc04-camera/videos. Videos are AVI files limited to 60 seconds or 128 MiB. Photos and videos can be viewed and edited in the Photo Channel.

Requires IOS58 and an SD card to save.

Tested with the Ubisoft / Hercules WC04 camera (photos and silent video) and a W2 webcam, USB ID 0c45:6366 (photos, video and sound at every size). Other UVC 1.0 MJPEG cameras may work.
longDescriptionDraft:
A Wii USB camera app, inspired by ZodiaKGalXy's GBAtemp request.

Features a live preview, countdown timers, and the ability to record videos both with and without sound (assuming your webcam has a compatible microphone).

It's in early development, so many USB cameras may not work yet. More features are planned for the future.

name: WiiEAS
shortDescription: Live EAS alerts from the United States
longDescription:
WiiEAS shows live Emergency Alert System messages from the GlobalEAS Central Alert Repository on your Wii, in the style of offical DASDEC alerts.

Browse active alerts with left/right. Press A to play the alert audio. Leave it running with auto-play on by pressing B, and new alerts play as they appear.

Plus/Start opens a menu showing information about the currently playing alert. Hold HOME/Start to exit the application.

Be responsible when using this app and keep the volume at a reasonable level.

The audio signals streamed in this app contain unmodified SAME data codes, which if picked up by a nearby microphone, smart speaker, ham radio, or PC running decoder software, could accidentally trigger real emergency alert systems. Broadcasting these tones over the internet or over radio waves may violate federal laws and result in severe penalties.

You are solely responsible for how and where the audio is played. The author is not liable for misuse of the tones provided by this application.

Data: alerts.globaleas.org (public). Idea originally proposed by RetrokVR.
longDescriptionDraft:
